topNews.text: Oregon Records 5 Years of Zero Pesticide-Related Deaths in Bees
topNews.excerpt: According to an inaugural report on the health of bees in Oregon, scientists at Oregon State University have found no incidences of pesticide-related bee deaths since 2021.
